_about: Zombies-style points. awards: a hit that does not kill pays `hit`; the killing blow pays ONE of kill / headshot_kill / melee_kill instead. headshot: head_share = the top part of an enemy's height that counts as its head (an enemy in enemies.json may carry its own head_share; 0 = it has no head), damage_mult = how much harder a head hit lands. max = the most points one character can hold. Points are saved with the character and are separate from casino coins.
